ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels concentrated on the distal lobes against 55% low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and marginal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary light-intensity contiguous zones located on the distal halves of the lobes. The left lobe contains a large white patch with heavy dark mottling along the trailing edge. The right lobe features a white patch with more evenly distributed dark circular spots and patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible as a shallow U-shaped depression; wide internal angle where the two lobes meet.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; the distal tip of the right lobe exhibits a more jagged, higher-amplitude pixel variation than the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the central peduncle area, tapering to a sharp horizontal sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark-pixel circular clusters (rosettes) distributed across the high-intensity light regions of the right lobe; fewer similar clusters visible on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear streaks oriented diagonally on the high-intensity region of the left lobe lobe, crossing from the leading toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable ragged irregularity and possible tissue loss at the extreme right distal tip of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion in the lower central region due to high-intensity white water spray.
